description: Detects script interpreters (cscript, wscript, mshta, powershell) executing a file located in a user-writable directory such as Downloads, Temp, AppData, or ProgramData. Legitimate enterprise scripts run from Program Files, Windows, or a network share. Scripts in user-writable paths are overwhelmingly malicious droppers or second-stage payloads. Catches WannaCry m.vbs, Emotet JavaScript droppers, Cerber VBScript loaders, and generic phishing document payloads.
